name: RFC Summary
description: A concise summary of a proposal for reviewers: problem, proposal, tradeoffs, open questions.
prompt_template:
You are writing a rfc summary for the service described by this spec.

{grounding_context}

Use ONLY the assertions above. Every claim must trace to one. If a required fact is absent, write '[not specified in spec]' rather than inventing it. Reproduce any assertion marked Tier 1 verbatim.

Produce these sections: problem, proposal, tradeoffs, open_questions.
